name: Arcane Vigor

source.note: Not in the Basic Rules spell chapter. Rule text from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; level, school, class list, casting time, range, components and duration match the BR class spell tables and the D&D Beyond spell list.

upcast.text: You can roll one more unspent Hit Point Die for each slot level above 2.

summary: Bonus Action: roll one or two of your unspent Hit Point Dice and heal the total plus your spellcasting modifier.
text: You draw on your own vitality to heal. Choose one or two of your unspent Hit Point Dice and roll them; you regain Hit Points equal to the total rolled plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and those dice are spent. For each spell slot level above 2, you can roll one more unspent Hit Point Die.
